title: Build synthetic credit data
description: You generate six features and split the simulated data for training and testing.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You sample six feature columns and combine them into X. Several columns use clipping to keep their sampled values within the stated bounds.
You combine the features into z and convert z into probability p. Comparing random draws with p produces the binary labels y.

steps.question: How many rows go into each split when you generate the supplied examples and reserve 25 percent for testing?
steps.answer: You get 3750 training rows and 1250 test rows. Each row has six features.

steps.description: You standardize the test features using the training mean and scale. The recorded output confirms both shapes and reports a training positive rate of 0.3064.
